headline: Fisherman’s Row Leads Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, Fisherman’s Row has become the freshest active base front: its divided line stands at five Colonial strategic bases to four Warden, with two ownership events in the latest two hours and 21 across the day, the newest recorded at 05:40. Linn Mercy remains unsettled at nine Warden bases against two Colonial, though its four events in six hours came before a quiet latest two-hour window. Lykos Isle likewise holds at five Warden to two Colonial, with two events in six hours and nine over 24. Deadlands remains the largest and bloodiest ledger, divided eight Colonial to three Warden; two events in six hours accompany sharply accelerating losses on both sides. Marban Hollow shows heavy recent casualties and 15 daily ownership events, but no movement in the latest two hours. Stlican Shelf, at eight Warden bases to one Colonial, has recorded six daily events while its immediate battle tempo cools. Elsewhere, Stonecradle and Endless Shore retain signs of earlier movement, but their latest ownership activity has gone quiet.
